name.description: Name shown in the left panel.

color.description: Palette colour of the connection. It paints the row rail in the left panel.

read_only.description: Refuse writes from the console and the grid.

mode.description: fields connects with host, port, database, username and password. uri connects with one URI.

host.description: Server host. Fields mode; not for sqlite, sqs and s3.

port.description: Server port. Fields mode; not for sqlite, sqs and s3.

database.description: Database name. For sqlite the absolute file path; for sqs and s3 the AWS region.

username.description: User name. For sqs and s3 the AWS profile.

password.description: Secret reference ${secret:name}. Fields mode only. Set the value in Kira, in the connection's secrets section.

uri.description: Secret reference ${secret:name} that holds the whole connection URI. Uri mode only. Set the value in Kira, in the connection's secrets section.

options.description: Driver options, such as sslmode. A secret option such as a key passphrase needs uri mode.

preconnect.description: A command Kira runs before it connects, such as an SSH tunnel.

command.description: Shell command. Never interpolated: ${...} stays literal text.

sidecar.description: Keep the command running and drop the connection when it exits.

delay_sec.description: Seconds to wait after the command starts before the first connect.

auto_explain.description: Run EXPLAIN before every SELECT the console runs and warn about costly plans.

throttle_per_sec.description: Commands per second this connection is paced to. 0 is unlimited, otherwise 0.01 to 1000.

mcp.description: What an AI client may do through the DB MCP server.

enabled.description: Expose the connection to the DB MCP server.

description.description: What the database is for. Shown to the AI client.

auto_explain.description: Run EXPLAIN before an agent's SELECT or WITH and refuse it when the estimated rows read reach advanced.expensiveQueryRows.

review_results.description: Legacy: applies to every mode that review leaves unset. inherit follows the app setting; review always holds results for a look; send never holds them.

review.description: Result review per mode. An unset mode follows review_results, else inherit. inherit follows the app setting; review always holds results for a look; send never holds them.

statement_timeout_sec.description: Seconds each statement an agent runs may take; 0 turns the timeout off.

tables.description: Tables, views or collections MCP statements may touch. Absent allows all, including later ones; an empty list allows none. Entry format: postgres database.schema.name; mysql, mariadb, clickhouse, mongodb database.name; sqlite and kibana name. Wrap a part in double quotes when it holds a dot. Not for redis, kafka, s3 or sqs.

masks.description: Columns whose values the DB MCP server hides.

column.description: Column name. Matching is by column name, ignoring case.

keep_hint.description: Keep the kind's small hint: initials of a name, domain of an email, year of a date.

correlate.description: Add a keyed tag so equal values stay recognisable. Not for number.

mask_review.description: Column review for masking. Absent turns it off. Present, a column that no mask rule covers and that is not listed here is withheld from MCP results until the user reviews it. Not for mongodb, redis, kafka, s3, sqs or kibana.

columns.description: Columns the user reviewed. Entry format: the table entry of the kind plus the column, for example postgres database.schema.table.column; mysql, mariadb, clickhouse database.table.column; sqlite table.column. Wrap a part in double quotes when it holds a dot.

tree.description: What the left panel hides for this connection.

hidden_kinds.description: Object kinds to hide, such as sequence.

hidden_paths.description: Object paths to hide, such as public/audit_log.

schema_ddl.description: DDL text for the SQL editor's completion and diagnostics.
